### Change log: 2026-10-19, four-book pass (Darth Plagueis, Revenge of the Sith novel, Labyrinth of Evil, Revan)
Backup before editing: verdicts.md.bak-2026-10-19-books. Sources: darth-plagueis-notes.md, rots-novel-notes.md, labyrinth-of-evil-notes.md, revan-novel-notes.md (each one's "Proposed verdicts.md changes" section). In every entry touched, x/10 scores and percentages were replaced with diff and confidence words, versions were named, and amps were stated.
Changed (existing entries):
1. Strongest Legends character: Vitiate's Nyriss quote verified in the novel (Revan Ch28 L6001); the Nathema void is corroborated on page; Vitiate/Sidious version ladder added. Confidence wording medium-low -> low-medium (same meaning).
2. Sidious vs Plagueis: verdict kept (Sidious at his ROTS-era peak), now high diff, low-medium. Added chapter/line cites, how the Ch30 murder went (an ambush), Luceno's "merely more clever" framing, and version tags (post-boost Sidious; DE Sidious excluded as an amp; prime Plagueis includes the ~41 BBY shift amp; TPM Sidious is pre-boost).
3. Yoda vs Sidious: kept Sidious, high diff, medium. Added Stover's beats (Ch20) and Yoda's strategic exit and method-failure lines. Flagged that the JN disarm and podium push are not in Stover. Added the LoE statements (L4193, L4245). Removed 6/10.
4. Yoda vs Mace: kept Yoda, mid-high, medium-high; the Vaapad loop is now cited (ROTS Ch17 L6691). Removed 7.5/10.
5. Mace vs Sidious: kept Sidious, now mid-high diff. Confidence raised medium -> medium-high (in the novel, Anakin is at the door before the disarm). Added "too strong for me" before the fake surrender, and the LoE concealment context. Removed 7/10.
6. Yoda vs Dooku: kept Yoda, now mid diff, high. Added Dooku's LoE admission (L2451) and Yoda's L4243 line. Removed 8/10.
7. Mace vs Dooku: kept Mace, high diff, low-medium. Added Dooku's LoE ladder (L3347), Grievous's L4929 line and the Vaapad loop. Removed 6/10.
8. Dooku vs Maul: kept Dooku, mid, medium. Added Plagueis's «more skilled than he actually is» (Ch23 L5215) and the Garyn hand wound (Ch28 L6441). Removed 6.5/10.
9. Vader vs Dooku: SPLIT by Vader version. Unsuited Mustafar Vader: Vader, mid, medium-high. Newly suited Vader: toss-up leaning Dooku, high, low. Later suited prime: Vader, mid-high, low-medium (down from medium). Amended the "For Dooku" bullet with LoE L1669–1671 and L3349. Removed 6.5/10.
10. Sidious vs Dooku: kept Sidious, high; diff set to low-mid. Added ROTS (L1351–1353, L1505, L3509) and LoE (L2445, L3299, L5261) cites.
11. Exar Kun vs Revan: now pinned to Revan Reborn. Revan, high diff; confidence low -> low-medium (new Nyriss kill and the Emperor opening). Removed 5.5/10.
12. Plagueis vs Mace: kept Plagueis, mid-high, low-medium. Replaced "shrugging off Sidious's lightning" with the accurate Ch30 description, and corrected "marionette control of Venamis" (the marionette was Plagueis's own body). Added the Ch6 dueling credential and the Venamis duel. Removed 6/10 and the x/10 cross-references.
13. Revan vs the Exile: game versions kept (Revan, mid-high, medium). Added a novel-version split (Revan Reborn over the novel's Meetra, low-mid, medium-high). Replaced "she dies to Scourge" with the backstab caveat (Ch28 L6069-6071). Noted that L5535 is about growth, not parity. Removed 6.5/10.
14. Maul (TPM) vs Obi-Wan (ROTS): kept Obi-Wan, mid, medium. Added Sidious's «overcome by a lesser one» (Darth Plagueis, Epilogue, L7317) as support for the TPM-rematch Maul lean only. Removed 7/10.
15. Tier list: Plagueis moved to the head of tier 4 (now judged ≥ Yoda); Plagueis, Vitiate, Vader and Revan version notes added; Grievous placed provisionally (bottom of tier 6 / top of tier 7); Nyriss, Scourge and ROTS Obi-Wan added to "Not placed yet"; Exile slot reaffirmed; all x/10 in the tier lines converted to diff words.
Added (new entries, in the "Four-book pass" block):
16. Yoda (ROTS) vs Plagueis (prime): Plagueis, slight; high diff; low.
17. Plagueis (67 BBY) vs Venamis: Plagueis, mid, low (mini-entry; Tenebrous speed note attached).
18. Grievous (LoE, before the crush) vs Jedi Knights: Grievous, low, high.
19. Mace (Vaapad) vs Grievous (LoE): Mace, low-mid, high.
20. Dooku vs Grievous (LoE): Dooku, mid, medium-high.
21. Grievous (LoE) vs Council Masters: the Master, mid (Shaak Ti/Stass closer to high), medium.
22. Dooku vs pre-fall Anakin (ROTS): Anakin, mid, medium (rage available); sabers only, no rage: near even, high, low. Supersedes LoE's provisional Dooku-over-calm-Anakin lean.
23. Obi-Wan (ROTS) vs Grievous (ROTS, Utapau): Obi-Wan, low-mid with sabers / mid-high unarmed, medium-high.
24. Obi-Wan (ROTS) vs unsuited Mustafar Vader: as fought, Obi-Wan, high diff, high; neutral ground, Obi-Wan, high diff, low.
25. Revan vs Vitiate (novel versions): Reborn vs base, Vitiate, mid, high; vs the fed Emperor, low-mid, low; DK1 Revan (+Malak), low, high; 3v1, unresolved, lean Vitiate, high, low.
26. Revan Reborn vs Scourge (mortal): Revan, low, high.
27. The novel's Meetra vs Scourge (mortal): toss-up, slight Meetra, high, low.
28. Revan Reborn vs Nyriss: Revan, low, high.
29. Nyriss vs Scourge + the novel's Meetra: Nyriss, mid, medium.
Conflicts judged: (a) LoE's Dooku-over-calm-Anakin lean yields to the ROTS duel: Anakin, mid diff; calm sabers-only is near even. (b) The novel's Meetra is a separate, lower showing; the Exile's tier and the game-version Revan vs Exile call do not move. (c) Sidious vs Dooku diff: low (LoE) vs low-to-mid (ROTS), recorded as low-mid. (d) Mace vs Dooku confidence: LoE said medium is defensible, ROTS said only mild support; kept at low-medium. (e) Obi-Wan vs Grievous: ROTS (low-mid) and LoE (mid) are about different Grievous versions (after and before the chest crush), so both stand. (f) Suited prime Vader vs Dooku: confidence dropped to low-medium, because the old reasoning used pre-fall Anakin's feat. (g) Revan vs Exile game-version diff: the Revan worker leaned mid; kept mid-high.
Not applied here (other files, outside this task): the Plagueis worker's fill-in for debates-plagueis-vs-sidious.md (sorcerer's-ways quote is Ch23, L5255), and the ROTS worker's statement-bank additions (S16–S51) for the per-character quote files.
